Chapter 311: Chapter 12: Which Peak Master Has Advanced to the Seventh Rank? (Subscribe Please)_2

“`

Continuously condensing all sorts of spatial models, over nine hundred basic spatial models came together like pillars, thoroughly supporting an entirely independent space within Lin Yuan’s Dantian Qi Sea.

“A world…”

Lin Yuan observed the changes within the Qi Sea of his Dantian.

Creating a small space isn’t a difficult task for a Sixth Rank Evolver, as long as they comprehend one or two basic spatial models they can achieve it.

In the Immortal Tao World, a Mahayana Phase Heaven Lord could use the heaven-grade technique ‘Cosmos in the Sleeve’ to temporarily create a ‘Sleeve Space.’

...

But to create a small world is incredibly difficult, unlike the rigid space, a world can continuously absorb external energy to grow.

The most powerful aspect of an Eighth Layer Evolver is that with every move, they can harness the power of their inner world, a terrifying force far surpassing the individual’s own.

And with the support of an inner world, an Eighth Layer Evolver is very hard to kill, able to recover from even the most grievous injuries.

Of course.

Here, the injuries referred to are those of the physical body, as for injuries to the soul, it depends on the specific circumstances.

The soul… is extremely mysterious. Over a million years ago, the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin died under a soul attack, unable to send out any message before death.

“The embryonic form of a world has already taken shape…”

Lin Yuan’s attention was mostly focused on that separate space deep within the Qi Sea of his Dantian.

With the addition of nine hundred and sixty-five basic spatial models, the Power of Taiyin and Power of Taiyang, which formed the power of Taiji, seemed to have gone through some type of qualitative change. The aura shifted, quickly becoming perfected.

The embryonic form of a small world faintly appeared.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly changed.

With the appearance of the embryonic form of the small world.

Lin Yuan suddenly felt an unprecedented sense of ‘hunger.’

Hungry.

Hungry.

Hungry.

I’m starving to death.

The small world’s embryonic form.

Began to crazily absorb the energy inside Lin Yuan’s body.

In fact.

With Lin Yuan’s control, he could completely cut off this absorption.

But if he did that, it might affect the foundation of the Taiji Small World.

“Thankfully, I came prepared.”

With a thought from Lin Yuan.

Bottle after bottle appeared before him.

They were filled with vast amounts of ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid.’

Before his breakthrough, Lin Yuan had prepared everything he might need.

To open up an inner world, a tremendous amount of energy is inevitably consumed, and relying solely on one’s own absorption, who knows how long that would take.

Therefore, Lin Yuan had, in advance, applied for enough ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid.’

‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid’ can replenish the energy consumed within the body, and has many uses. The Red Kun Lineage has a stable channel for acquiring ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid.’

Actually, in terms of replenishing oneself, the effect of Cosmic Crystal Stones should far surpass that of Scarlet Spirit Liquid, a resource needed by Eighth Layer Evolvers and even stronger beings.

But Lin Yuan was reluctant to use them.

Despite obtaining one thousand Cubic Cosmic Crystals from Ou Yin’s legacy, these were ‘hard currency’ among various cosmic races, and using any would mean having less.

While the effect of Scarlet Spirit Liquid was somewhat inferior, it was free and cost nothing.

“Eat, eat.”

Lin Yuan drank the ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid’ in big gulps, and the gentle power flowed swiftly into the Qi Sea of his Dantian through his limbs and bones.

The embryonic form of the Taiji Small World started to fill up at a visible rate.

…

Above the Chikun Main Star.

The Chikun Star Lord and the twelve Peak Masters were carefully observing the fluctuations in Lin Yuan’s aura during his breakthrough.

“Hmm… Little Junior Brother has a very stable foundation, seems like he has made ample preparations, the breakthrough hasn’t encountered any hitches, but why is he lingering at the Sixth Rank Peak?”

The Third Senior Brother was also observing carefully, although he had already stepped into the Seventh Rank, watching and feeling more can’t do him any harm.

“Not sure.”

“Perhaps he’s sensing the subtle changes from Sixth Rank to Seventh Rank?”

“Maybe, little Junior Brother really is… Other Evolvers, even us, when breaking through from Sixth to Seventh Rank, can’t wait to step right into it, yet little Junior Brother is leisurely… geez, comparing people…”

The Second Senior Brother sighed.

For a Sixth Rank Evolver, stepping into the Seventh Rank is undoubtedly the most coveted thing.

“`

“`

No sixth-rank evolver could stay at the door to the seventh rank and shake it without immediately entering.

“Judging by the changes in aura, little junior brother’s entry into the seventh rank should be a sure thing…”

The eldest senior brother declared decisively, having taken less than two years to complete the entire journey from sixth rank to the peak of the seventh rank, and the breakthrough was so smooth.

The eldest senior brother simply thought Lin Yuan was abnormal.

When he recalled the many setbacks and trials he faced when breaking through to the seventh rank… compared with his little junior brother.

“Hm?”

Compared to the twelve peak masters who were overwhelmed with emotion.

At this moment, despite the calm appearance of the Chikun Star Lord, there was a look of surprise and uncertainty in his heart.

“How do I feel the opening of a space?”

The Chikun Star Lord was keenly sensing the changes in the aura coming from the Thirteen Peaks below.

Worried about affecting Lin Yuan’s breakthrough, the Chikun Star Lord dared not extend his perception into the Thirteen Peaks, he could only rely on his own experience and the fluctuations of the power of space to speculate on some matters.

“Could it be?”

The Chikun Star Lord himself, a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, was a special space life-form and was extremely sensitive to the fluctuations of space.

At this moment, he faintly perceived that the spatial fluctuations produced by Lin Yuan’s breakthrough were somewhat different from the normal transition from sixth rank to seventh.

“Could it be some special space treasure, or…”

The Chikun Star Lord thought for a moment and couldn’t help but speculate.

He was just curious and had no other thoughts; after all, which evolver who managed to cultivate to the sixth or seventh rank didn’t have some sort of special opportunity?

The Chikun Star Lord had his own, as did the twelve peak masters, so it was only natural for Lin Yuan to have a special space treasure.

Time passed.

Another half-day went by.

“It should be stable now.”

“Let’s go wait outside the Thirteen Peaks.”

Feeling that Lin Yuan’s aura had fully stepped into the seventh rank, the Chikun Star Lord led the twelve peak masters towards the outside of the Thirteen Peaks.

“Little junior brother, you’ve really kept us in the dark.”

“Indeed, this time we must find out exactly how he has been cultivating…”

“Ah… what do you say, when we meet him, should I call him senior brother or junior brother…”

The twelve peak masters talked amongst themselves, while the fourth to twelfth masters were somewhat conflicted.

In the human civilization of the universe, unless it’s a direct blood relative, strength takes precedence.

That is to say, even if a seventh-rank evolver is younger, a sixth-rank evolver must treat them as an elder upon meeting.

The fourth peak master and the others weren’t reluctant to call Lin Yuan senior brother, but having called him junior brother so many times before, the sudden change of status was a bit unfamiliar to them.

…..

Chikun Main Star.

As the most prosperous planet in a star domain.

The Chikun Main Star is filled with many powerful evolvers, with fourth and fifth ranks seen everywhere, and there were also numerous sixth rank fallen star warriors, and even seventh rank evolvers.

Under the perception of so many powerful beings, the breakthrough aura emanating from the heart of the main star was naturally noticed by many sixth-rank evolvers.

“Someone in the Red Kun lineage has broken through to the seventh rank?”

“The Chikun Star Lord’s level of mentoring disciples is really impressive.”

“True, it’s a pity the Chikun Star Lord doesn’t take many disciples, in ten thousand years he has only taken the thirteen peak masters…”

The sixth-rank evolvers on the main star chatted with each other, praising the Chikun Star Lord’s teaching methods.

“Right.”

“Who do you think is the peak master that broke through to the seventh rank this time?”

A sixth-rank evolver asked out of curiosity.

They were unaware that at this moment, all twelve peak masters were not on Chikun Main Star.

“It should be the fourth peak master, right? The fourth peak master has been at the sixth rank the longest, has the deepest accumulation, and is closest to the seventh rank.”

“I think that’s not right, the sixth peak master has the best talent and a special physique. Among the Chikun Star Lord’s disciples, I think he’s the most likely to step into the seventh rank.”

“The sixth peak master is indeed very likely, but in earlier years, the sixth peak master was injured in a battle with a different species, which might affect his breakthrough to the seventh rank, I think the eighth peak master is the most likely.”

“The eighth peak master? I think it’s the fifth peak master…”

…

The multitude of sixth-rank evolvers guessed all the nine peak masters, from the fourth to the twelfth, one by one.

Each of these nine masters was at the peak of the sixth-rank, and being a disciple of a star lord, they all had the potential to step into the seventh rank.

Though opinions among the sixth-rank evolvers differed, there was a unified understanding, or perhaps an assumption.

That was, the peak master who was breaking through definitely could not be the thirteenth peak master.
